sources.title: Zelle transfer limits
sources.page_scope: Zelle sending limits for consumer and small business accounts
sources.claim: Consumer daily send limits by enrollment age: <=30 days $1,000/10 txns; 31-60 days $2,000/10; >60 days $3,500/10; monthly $20,000/60 txns. Unenrolled recipients $500/day; new recipients (first 5 days) $2,000/day. Minimum $1.00. No receive limit stated. No fee to send or receive. Small business: daily $2,000/$4,000/$8,000/$15,000 by enrollment age (20 txns), monthly $100,000/120 txns; unenrolled $2,000/day; new recipient $4,000/day. Private Bank and Merrill clients may have higher limits.
caveats: Effective date August 27, 2026 shown on page.

CONTRADICTION: a search-engine snippet of this same URL (older index) showed consumer limits of $3,500/24h (10), $10,000/7 days (30), $20,000/30 days (60) and a $3,500 single-payment max; the fetched page shows enrollment-age tiers and no 7-day tier. Fetched page recorded as current.
No mention of SafeBalance/child restrictions on this page.
sources.local_note: Effective 2026-08-27: consumer Zelle daily $1,000 (<=30d), $2,000 (31-60d), $3,500 (>60d), 10 txns; monthly $20,000/60; unenrolled recipient $500/day; new recipient $2,000/day first 5 days; min $1; no fee.

sources.title: Wire transfers in Online Banking and Mobile app
sources.page_scope: Domestic and international wire transfer product page with fee table and FAQs
sources.claim: Outbound wire fees: domestic $30; international in foreign currency $0 wire fee (exchange rate markup applies); international in USD $45. Inbound wires may incur $15 per wire. Cutoff 5 p.m. ET. Domestic typically same day; international 1-5 business days. International wires cancellable within 30 minutes for full refund. Requires debit card/PIN/US mobile number or USB security key; amounts above account limits require Secured Transfer or USB Security Key. SafeBalance Family Banking: parent owner can send/receive wires, child cannot. USD-only countries listed.
caveats: Doc code MAP9043678-01272028 only; no readable date.
Preferred Rewards Diamond/Diamond Honors wire-fee waivers seen only in search snippet of this domain, not confirmed in fetched text.
sources.local_note: Outbound wire: domestic $30; intl foreign currency $0 + FX markup; intl USD $45; inbound may incur $15; cutoff 5 p.m. ET; intl cancel within 30 min; Family Banking child cannot send wires.

sources.title: Mobile Check Deposit
sources.page_scope: Mobile check deposit product page and FAQs
sources.claim: Photograph front and back of endorsed check, select account, enter amount, submit. Monthly limit exists and is displayed when selecting deposit account (amount not public). Funds not available for immediate withdrawal; before cutoff on business day generally available next business day. Eligible: personal, business, government/treasury, cashier's checks from US institutions in USD. Ineligible: foreign checks, money orders, traveler's checks, savings bonds, IRDs, third-party checks. No additional fee. Not available to the child on SafeBalance for Family Banking.
caveats: Page references 'cutoff time' without stating the hour (see CR-BA-05).
Endorsement wording and check retention period not stated on fetched page.
sources.local_note: Mobile deposit: monthly limit shown in app only; no fee; next-business-day availability before cutoff; ineligible foreign/money orders/third-party checks; not available to Family Banking child.

sources.title: Cutoff times
sources.page_scope: Help page listing processing cutoff times by service
sources.claim: Mobile check deposit: before 9:00 p.m. ET (Eastern/Central) or 8:00 p.m. PT (Mountain/Pacific) on a business day generally available next business day. Transfers between BofA deposit accounts credited immediately; to BofA credit accounts 11:59 p.m. ET; to Merrill investment accounts 4:45 p.m. ET. Transfers to other banks 8:00 p.m. ET for next-business-day or 3-business-day; wires 5:00 p.m. ET. Zelle typically minutes for enrolled recipients. Bill Pay: credit cards 11:59 p.m. ET; other billers 5:00 p.m. ET.
caveats: No visible update date.
Fees referenced only as 'may apply' with pointer to service agreement.
sources.local_note: Cutoffs: mobile deposit 9 p.m. ET / 8 p.m. PT; BofA deposit-to-deposit transfers immediate; Merrill 4:45 p.m. ET; external transfers 8 p.m. ET; wires 5 p.m. ET; Bill Pay 11:59 p.m. ET cards / 5 p.m. ET others.

sources.title: Online Banking Service Agreement
sources.page_scope: Legal agreement governing Online/Mobile Banking incl. Bill Pay, Zelle, ACH and wire transfers
sources.claim: Section 6 limits table (consumer): Next Business Day ACH outbound $1,000 per transaction, $0.00 fee; inbound Next Business Day and Three Business Day ACH $1,000 receiving limit, $0.00 fee (must first receive $500 aggregate via 3-day inbound before next-day inbound where applicable); same-business-day domestic wire $1,000 limit, $30 fee; international wire $1,000 limit, $45 USD / no fee in foreign currency plus markup. Small business next-day ACH $5,000 $5 fee; 3-day ACH $5,000 $1 fee. Higher limits possible by adding Secured Transfer or registering a USB security key. Bill payments up to $99,999.99; no Bill Pay service fees. Zelle: no fee to send or receive; consumer $3,500/day (10), $20,000/month (60) after 60 days.
caveats: Effective August 27, 2026.
Long legal document read through a summarizing fetch; table values should be re-verified against the raw agreement before binding rules.
No SafeBalance/Family Banking text found in the agreement.
Third-party sites cite $3 standard / $10 next-day outbound external transfer fees; NOT found in this official agreement (which lists $0 consumer fee) — not used as evidence.
sources.local_note: Agreement eff. 2026-08-27: consumer next-day ACH outbound $1,000/txn $0; inbound ACH $1,000/txn $0; domestic wire $1,000 base limit $30; intl wire $45 USD; Secured Transfer/USB key may raise limits; Bill Pay up to $99,999.99, no fee; Zelle no fee.
